args.description: Game skill effect sprite, side view: one huge diagonal sword-slash crescent arc sweeping from upper left down to lower right, thick in the middle and tapering to sharp points, hot white core edged with pale steel-blue then a thin warm amber rim, fine parallel speed streaks inside the arc, a burst of white-yellow sparks and small cut flecks flying off the lower tip. Detailed 16-bit pixel art in the same art style and palette mood as the reference swamp monster: solid parts (rock, mud, metal shards) have bold dark outlines and 3-4 step shading; glowing energy parts are bright with a hot near-white core fading to saturated color, crisp stepped pixel edges, no blur. Layered composition: a bright core shape, secondary shapes, and small scattered particles. Only the effect: no characters, no people, no creatures, no weapons, no shields, no text, no letters, transparent background.
